name: Biu

attempts.outcome: Loaded. The site identifies BOGIS as responsible for Borno land administration, title, registration, searches, and a land database. It provides no public parcel map/API link in the fetched page.

Official regulation states that the BOGIS Digital Data Repository is the official state repository, includes land-use cadastre, and contains the BOGIS Land Administration System and Cadastral Administration System. It specifies UTM 32N/Minna as the official coordinate system and says maps/data can be viewed or downloaded, but it exposes no anonymous parcel feature endpoint.

attempts.route: BOGIS application portal landing page and current JavaScript/configuration
attempts.outcome: Loaded the current portal bundle and anonymous landing-page configuration. It is a citizen self-service application workflow with registration/login and document/application submission; no anonymous cadastral map or parcel search was exposed.
Both bounded anonymous requests returned HTTP 404. This is a route miss only; it does not establish absence of cadastral data or citywide absence.
robots.txt loaded; sitemap.xml returned 404. No parcel API route was disclosed.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier only, if a first-party parcel response is later verified
scopeLimits: No parcel geometry or native parcel ID response was returned, so no GeoJSON sample was retained.
BOGIS state-level custodian evidence is distinct from verified Biu-specific open parcel coverage.
The exact WUP point was preserved and not shifted; no exact-point miss, extent miss, timeout, login wall, or unusable portal is treated as evidence of citywide absence.
No unsafe owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax, account, applicant, or personal fields were requested or retained.
Runtime readiness remains held pending independent serial qualification of a real adapter.
uncertainty: BOGIS documents a real local/state cadastral and land-registry mandate and a digital repository/CAS, but its public pages and current anonymous portal did not expose a safe vector parcel service. Coverage and source-native identity for Biu remain unverified.
